purpose: Visual and UX design reference for OPD1 Tracker. Describes how the UI should look and feel. Does NOT prescribe the technical stack, dependencies, or architecture of the application — those are governed by AGENTS.md, package.json, and the actual source code. This file must never override the project's established stack, dependencies, API contracts, or repository architecture.

headings.usage: Used for all main metrics (KD, ACS, RR), player names, and dashboard headers. Provides a bold, tactical athletic feel that fits a competitive tracker.

body.usage: Highly legible, slightly technical font for tables, lists, and secondary data. Perfect for high information density.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-zinc-800. Use exposed skeleton grids for technical aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal to none. Rely on 1px solid strokes or subtle inner glows for definition, avoiding soft muddy shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Flat, matte finish. Avoid glassmorphism as it detracts from data legibility.
visual_enhancers.radius: Strict 4px (rounded-sm or rounded-md) for sharp, precise desktop feel.

layouts.app_shell: Flex layout: Left Sidebar Navigation (w-64 or w-16 collapsed) + Main Content (flex-1). Fixed Bottom Status Bar (h-10).
layouts.live_match: High-density Grid. Two-column split (grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-2) for Ally vs Enemy teams. Highly compressed table rows for players.
layouts.competitive: Bento Grid Pattern. Top span for the RR line chart and Current Rank card. Bottom for dense stat split tables.
layouts.spacing: Tight spacing (gap-2 to gap-4) within data tables. Generous padding (p-6) around major container edges.
layouts.alignment: Left-align text columns, right-align numeric metrics (KD, Win %, RR). Never center-align tabular data.

component_guidance.navigation: Persistent left sidebar. Highlight active route with brand accent left-border and lighter background. Include clear labels.
component_guidance.status_bar: Fixed at window bottom. Display client states (Offline, Lobby, Agent Select, In Game). Use bright badging (Red/Green/Yellow) to indicate status.
component_guidance.tables: Zebra striping (subtle bg-zinc-900/50) or border-b for row separation. Use explicit width for metric columns to maintain alignment.
component_guidance.player_row: Complex component: Agent avatar (left), Stacked Name/Rank, K/D, Headshot %, Win Rate, Smurf warning flag, Party color vertical bar indicator on the left edge.
component_guidance.badges: Sharp edges, uppercase (tracking-wider), distinct high-contrast colors. Prominently highlight 'Stale Data' and 'Smurf' indicators.
component_guidance.charts: Minimal axes lines, vibrant stroke for the primary line chart (RR progression), detailed custom tooltip. OPD1 currently renders charts as inline SVG (see `frontend/src/views/competitive/RRChart.tsx`); keep the visual language consistent if a new chart surface is added.

motion.hover: Instant background shift (bg-zinc-800), subtle border highlight.
motion.transitions: Use transition-colors transition-transform duration-200. Do NOT use 'transition-all'.
motion.lists: Minimal motion on desktop to preserve snappy, native application feel.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over domain colors (especially bright ones like Radiant or Platinum) uses proper contrast (e.g., black text over Radiant yellow).
accessibility.interactive: Clear focus rings (ring-brand) on all inputs, tabs, and buttons.

media.offline_hero: OPD1 ships a custom in-app OfflineHero component (`frontend/src/views/live/OfflineHero.tsx`). The previous external Unsplash hero image is not used.
media.valorant_assets: Fetch all external imagery (agents, ranks, maps, skins, cards) strictly from media.valorant-api.com.

design_notes_for_agents: This file describes how OPD1 should look and feel. It is not a license to change the stack.
Do NOT switch the frontend language, UI library, icon set, or chart library just to satisfy this file. Match what is already in `frontend/package.json` and the source tree.

Do NOT introduce new UI dependencies (Shadcn, Phosphor, Recharts, charting libraries, icon packs, etc.) unless the project has explicitly adopted them. The current OPD1 stack uses React + TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, custom UI primitives in `frontend/src/components/ui/`, and `lucide-react` for icons.
Use TypeScript (.ts/.tsx) and React 18 patterns consistent with the rest of the codebase. Do NOT introduce JavaScript (.js/.jsx) source files into the frontend.
Implement layout strictly with Tailwind CSS using Grid and Flexbox for the high-density tracker layouts.
DO NOT use generic centered text alignments. Left-align data/labels, right-align numbers.
Every interactive element and key informational wrapper MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="live-match-ally-table"`).
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds where text overlays images/content. Always use a solid background or a heavy backdrop filter.
Ensure 'Smurf' flags and 'Stale Data' badges are highly visible and visually alarming.
Do NOT use glassmorphism, cyberpunk, or retro terminal styles. Stick to a solid, flat, tactical 'Performance Pro' aesthetic designed for pure usability and readability.
Handle all 'Loading' and 'Empty/Offline' states elegantly. When VALORANT is not running, surface the in-app OfflineHero rather than rendering empty tables.
Real data only. The UI must never present demo/generated data as real. Backend demo payloads are marked `source:"demo"` / `demo:true`; gate live rendering on `source === "local"`.
